stem.en: For f(x, y) = x²y, what is the partial derivative with respect to x?
stem.et: Mis on funktsiooni f(x, y) = x²y osatuletis x-i järgi?

label.en: 2xy — y is held constant, so it stays in the answer as a coefficient
label.et: 2xy — y hoitakse konstantsena, seega jääb see vastusesse kordajana

label.en: 2x — differentiating with respect to x removes y altogether
label.et: 2x — x-i järgi diferentseerimine eemaldab y täielikult

label.en: x², since only the y factor is differentiated
It is undefined until the point is known to be an extremum
label.et: See on määramata, kuni ei ole teada, et punkt on ekstreemum
